newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi attacks petrol price hike.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi attacks petrol price hike.

text.p: The latest round of petrol price hikes is not justified, Treasury Minister carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Friday.
Distribution firms on Thursday and Friday upped the price of a litre of unleaded petrol by around 10 lire to a maximum of 1,925 lire, blaming dollar strength for the increase.
"Considering the two elements that I monitor daily, the dollar exchange rate and the price of crude, I don't see any reason for an increase in petrol prices," Ciampi told reporters.
"Indeed, since the start of the year, the cost of crude in lira has gone down," he added.
The Italian government said earlier it would investigate the price rise.
